response.sql: WITH telescope_avgs AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), first_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS rate FROM signals), kept AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_pulse_rate FROM telescope_avgs AS t CROSS JOIN first_baseline AS b WHERE t.avg_pulse_rate > b.rate), second_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS rate FROM kept) SELECT AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_pulse_rate, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - b1.rate) AS mean_excess_over_first_baseline, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - b2.rate) AS mean_excess_over_second_baseline FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN first_baseline AS b1 CROSS JOIN second_baseline AS b2 WHERE k.avg_pulse_rate > b2.rate;
